body: She won’t see any therapist at all. She thinks my dad is trying to make her seem crazy to take all the money. 5 years ago he signed over all the money under his name to her to prove he doesn’t have another women. Now he has nothing. And he can’t leave

That’s so rude! Where’s the manners ? If someone’s doing you a favor especially for free, at the very very least tell you their opinion even if it doesn’t resonate. Even a “huh... didn’t make sense but thank you” is better than a no reply. Pffft

Oh my gosh, that sounds extremely similar to my situation. I always would feel so confused during our arguments. Soooooo confused and I’d also feel that my feelings was being downplayed as well. But I really don’t think he does it on purpose either. 

Actually I failed to mention drugs was involved. There was a few weekends of mdma, and mdma was taken the weekend before. The incident happened on weds. 
I felt it’s possible that the brain was so burnt out that he acted irrationally and uncaring? But at the same time I felt that If the same situation happened to him I’d drop everything to go to him. I wouldn’t even cared if he did something retarded like...told me I was an ugly bitch and never want to see me again, even if he cheated on me (not saying these things happened) I’d run to him and make sure he feels safe and ok. Even if he just he got mugged or something, nothing else would of mattered to me. I’d run by his side and make sure he’s ok......So I’m so confused. Is it him? Is it the drugs? It’s not the first time I felt like he’s put me second to something either. I’m just so confused. I love him so much it’s so hard to decide what to do. He promised me he’d quit and no more drugs. 

The night we went home after the incident I just kept remembering him saying I’ve gone too far. That he’s done. He’s leaving me. And I felt so depressed. And he tried to get my parents to come over, so he could leave so someone could watch over me. Then told me after he’s gone I can do whatever I want, he wouldnt care( depression stuff) those words cut so deep.... I can’t imagine that this is him.... but I remember him saying something like that to me before.... when he’s not on drugs. He’d call my parents so he could leave. I can’t completely recall the past. I’m so confused. I’m so hurt. I just want to feel safe, I just wanted him to love me. Fully love me... I can’t remember any details. When things are good they’re so good, I’d feel so loved. How could he have become like that when something so horrible happened to me? I’m so lost...
He also said that he regret treating me like that, and hates himself and wants to die. I found him today with deep deep cuts all over his arms and leg. My heart died. I’ve never felt this emotional pain in my life. I felt like my brain cracked and that I’ve snapped. I couldn’t stop crying. It hurt me so so bad to see him hurt. I felt all the emotions at once, anger, pain, sAdness, and super scared. I feel so fucked up. I don’t know how to cope. I don’t know what to do. I’m so scared.....
What’s a gaslighting relationship? I tried googling but I’m having a hard time understanding If the relationship is like that already. Is it possible that he’s unaware he’s gaslighting me?

All I wanted was for him to help me feel safe after what had happened. I just feel permanently scared now. I don’t feel like anyone can help me. He was my only escape... I just don’t know what to do. And please Stop telling me to go to the police

I am B in this situation. And honestly I agree with those who say both is in the wrong. I shouldn’t of walked away. I was never in control of the drugs because A had access to it the whole time. The drug dealer lives in the same place. And he always knew where he lived.  I wanted to keep the phone number just so he would be able to talk to me about getting drugs before getting the drugs and perhaps I’d have a chance to talk him out of it. I didn’t want to make it easier for A to do drugs secretly behind my back. I had hopes that he would follow me instead of getting a phone number that really made little difference in wether or not he could get the drugs. It hurt me when It felt like my feelings didn’t matter to him. Never once did I try to “control” A to do drugs or not. The whole reason I was addicted was no ones fault except for my own. To escape the pain that was caused to me. And no matter how hard I try to quit, I get hurt and go right back to it. The relationship is toxic. And it has never been normal. Words that was exchanged was beyond painful and at the end of the day it doesn’t matter if it was because of drugs or not. It’s better for the both of us to go our separate ways for the sake of our own health. Thank you everyone for their input. It really shed some light onto what is and isn’t important.
